Fix three concrete bugs a red team found in PR 469 (branch `feat/collapse-large-sources-by-default`, change 267; head 6aea3f4a after `git fetch origin`; local branch `fix/collapse-redteam-three`; commit locally; I push). Read /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md and /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/redteam-collapse.md (D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D7 and the repros; its scratch generator is in /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/redteam-collapse/ for reference, do not commit it). Keep it SMALL, no new frameworks.
1. D1 silent loss (worst): `is_react_declared` (crates/semantic/src/component.rs:35) uses `declarations.iter().any(...)`, so a prop that the user or a dependency also declares (an intersection with a React type) is dropped. A prop is React's only when EVERY one of its declarations is in @types/react. Fix there and at the other consumers (types/semantic.rs apply_props ~376-380; `Unanswered::Drop`). Repros: `React.ComponentProps<'div'> & { className: 'mine'; onClick: (x:number)=>void; title: 'own'; own: string }` must keep own className/onClick/title; `DepBig & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { key?: string }` keeps key; `ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & Omit<DepBig,'onClick'>` keeps DepBig's className/style/id/children.
2. Double listing D2/D3/D4/D7: add ONE invariant at the one sink where the layer is finalised (the code that builds layers from the merged answer; find where `Layering`/`one_layer_per_collapsed_source` end up): a collapsed layer never holds a name that is also a listed prop of the component (listed wins; the layer keeps only members not listed); then drop the layer if it falls under the member threshold after that removal? NO: only remove the names, do not change the collapse decision (keep it small); notable props copied from a same-source layer stay (that is the layer contract). This fixes: type-literal alias source both collapsed and listed (D2), own redeclaration also held by the base layer (D3), `DepBig & Omit<DepBig,'a0'>` (D4), shared member in two layers (D7: also a name may be in only one layer, first wins).
3. D5: an Omit key set that is not a finite resolved union of string literals (`Omit<DepBig, string>`, `string & {}`, template literals, anything `resolve_key_set_or_warn` returns None for) currently reads as 'omits nothing', giving a layer of members that do not reach and phantom notable props. Rule: unresolved key set => that source is NOT collapsible (listed or, if the structural lane cannot list it, left to the checker) and no phantom notable. Fix at resolver/alias.rs:42-55 by marking the source selection-unknown, and make the single collapse decision treat selection-unknown as not collapsible (same as the checker-lane rule already added in 6aea3f4a).
Tests first in crates/semantic/tests/collapse_model.rs (the existing model): one case per repro above, plus an assertion in the model's invariant check that no name is both listed and in a layer (notable copies excepted) and that own props are never dropped. They must fail on base. NOT in scope (leave, list in the notes): D3 threshold counting, D6 destructuring defaults, D8 ambient by spelling, D9, D7 augmentation counts, out-of-scope items. Check: gate-large, chakra-only, shadcn-ui outputs identical to the 6aea3f4a build except where the three bugs applied (explain any difference; expected ~0-2 components), Button argTypes on Chakra still ~146, peak RSS chakra-only not worse. Gates (targeted): `just lint doc-check machete typos`; nextest `-p caliper-docgen-core -p caliper-docgen-semantic` (run `pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts` in the worktree first if snapshots need @types/react); `just test-checker-lane` once (symlink target/release in your worktree to your CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release). Then `/code-review low` once on your SHA range, fix only real bugs; notes to /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/fix-collapse-redteam-three.md (## What, ## Evidence, ## Not verified, session URL line). Final message at most 50 words: branch, SHA, exit codes, what remains.

# Red team: collapse decision and layering at fix/collapse-never-hide-on-silence (6aea3f4a)

Nothing was fixed and no repo file changed. The binary was built from `git archive 6aea3f4a` in `shrink/redteam-collapse-src`, with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=shrink/redteam-collapse-target` and rust 1.99.1.

Harness (scratch, not committed), in `/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/redteam-collapse/`:
- `gen.py` writes one project (`projects/g`) with 102 components. Each component is one grammar form over these sources:
  - dependency `dep`: interfaces of 201/200/199 members, a type-literal alias of 201, `*HTMLAttributes` of 29/30/31, `BoxStyleProps` 31, `DepChild extends DepBig` (narrows `a1`), `DepOther` (shares `a5` and `className`), `DepGen<T>`, an augmented `DepAug` (200 + 1 in `src/aug.ts`), a re-export;
  - project: an interface of 201, a type-literal alias of 201, `ProjBig200`, `ProjChild`, `ProjMid` 40.
- Lanes:
  - S `--no-checker`;
  - M default (merged);
  - C `--no-structural-fallback` (checker only);
  - and, under `dependencies`, also T `--semantic-timeout-ms 1` and N `--no-load-dependencies`.
- Each lane runs under all three modes, `dependencies` (the default and the addon's), `all` and `none`.
- `oracle.cjs` is the ground truth: TypeScript 5.9.3 `getPropertiesOfType` of each `Props_<id>` alias (the union of its arms for a union), with every declaration's parent and file.
- `analyze.py` checks the invariants and writes `rows.json`. A notable prop that copies a member of a same-source layer is the layer contract, not a duplicate.
- `corpus.sh` and `corpus.py` measure how often each class occurs, and the cost of the allow-list, on gate-large, chakra-only and shadcn-ui (`apps/v4`, 612 components).

## Invariant results

1. Every reaching prop appears exactly once (list, notable or layers). **Violated**: by loss in D1, by duplication in D2, D3, D4 and D7.
2. Own props are never in a layer. **Violated** in D3: an own redeclaration stays a layer member. In D3c an own prop is moved to `notableInherited` as the dependency's.
3. Every member of a collapsed layer reaches the component. **Violated** in D5 (an omitted key stays held, and props that do not exist appear). In D3 the base layer holds a member that a redeclaration overrides.
4. Lanes agree. On the 79 forms the structural lane can read, S, M and C collapse the same sources in all three modes. The decision still changes with how the type is spelled (D3b, D7). Checker-only forms (`Parameters<typeof f>[0]`, `Cfg['props']`) differ only because S cannot read them at all; that is expected.
5. Determinism. **Holds**:
   - M is byte-identical across two runs (stats dropped) in every mode.
   - Every component that shares a source without an Omit gets the same member list.
   - T (1 ms timeout) equals S on all 102 components.

Totals in `rows.json` (rows over modes and lanes, then distinct components):
- DUP: 3722 rows, 17 components;
- LOSS: 10101 rows, 21 components (most of it structural-lane loss on forms S declines, see Out of scope);
- LOSS_OWN: 22 rows, 2 components;
- LAYER_MEMBER_NOT_REACHING: 2424 rows, 3 components;
- PHANTOM: 467 rows, 4 components;
- LAYER_HOLDS_OVERRIDDEN_PROP: 30 rows, 4 components;
- OWN_AS_NOTABLE: 4 rows, 1 component;
- IN_TWO_LAYERS: 12 rows, 1 component;
- LANE_DISAGREE: 14 rows, 7 components (all checker-only forms).

## Discrepancy classes, grouped by the fact the decision lacked

### D1 (worst: silent loss in the default lane). "React's" means any one declaration is in @types/react
- Where:
  - `is_react_declared` (`crates/semantic/src/component.rs:35`) is `declarations.iter().any(...)`;
  - `apply_props` (`crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs:376-380`) drops every `react_declared` prop of a component that has a layer;
  - `Unanswered::Drop` then drops the structural prop as well.
- A prop that the user or a dependency also declares, in an intersection with a React type, is lost in M and C. The element layer stands for React's attribute, so the user's own type, JSDoc, and the name itself (`key`, `children`) are gone.
- Repros (M and C, every mode, `none` included):
  - `React.ComponentProps<'div'> & { className: 'mine'; onClick: (x: number) => void; title: 'own'; own: string }` loses `className`, `onClick` and `title`; S lists them (C_ownOverReact).
  - `DepBig & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { key?: string }` loses the own `key` (C_keyRef).
  - `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & Omit<DepBig, 'onClick'>` loses DepBig's `className`, `style`, `id` and `children` (C_cpwrAndDep).
  - The same happens wherever DepBig is listed, not collapsed: `ComponentProps<'div'> & DepBig` under `none`, and `Parameters<typeof f>[0] & ComponentProps<'div'>`, each lose 5 props.
- Missing fact: every declaration of the prop is React's (C1: one React declaration was taken as proof).
- Corpora: 0 detected. I compared S-lane props with a non-dependency parent, absent from M, in components with an element layer.
  - Latent case: Chakra `SystemProperties` members `color`, `content` and `translate` are also React names. They are safe today only because the source collapses (588 gate-large components). An Omit that drops the source under the threshold, in a component with an element layer, would lose them.

### D2. A type-literal alias source is both collapsed and fully listed (merged and checker lanes)
- Repros (M and C under `dependencies` and `all`; S is correct):
  - `DepAlias & {...}` and `ProjAlias & {...}`: the layer holds 201 members and the same 201 props are also listed;
  - a checker-only `PropsOf<typeof W>` with `W: FC<DepAlias>` does the same.
- Cause: the checker names no `parent` for a type-literal member. `keeps` keeps every prop with no parent (semantic.rs:692), and the structural layer holds members by (name, alias).
- This confirms review item 1 of the PR body as a regression.
- Missing fact: a type-literal member's binding to its alias.
- Corpora: 0.

### D3. A redeclared or overridden member stays in the layer and counts toward the threshold
- Repros (all lanes, `dependencies` and `all`, unless noted):
  - `interface P extends DepBig { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine' }`: the own `a1` and `className` are listed and also held by the DepBig layer (C_redeclare). The intersection form does the same (C_redeclareInter).
  - `DepChild` (a dependency child that narrows `a1`): the DepBig layer holds `a1`, and `a1` is listed (C_depChild). The same holds for ProjChild.
  - `interface P extends DepBig { a0: string }` (C_redeclareThreshold):
    - 201 declared, 200 reach, so the source should be listed at the threshold;
    - it collapses, and `a0` is both listed and in the layer.
  - `& { a0?: never }` and `Pick<DepBig,'a0'> & DepBig`: `a0` is listed and in the layer.
  - D3b (spelling): the structural lane counts what the source declares, the checker counts by parent. So the same type `DepChild` collapses DepBig at 201 when written directly. Written as `Parameters<typeof f>[0]`, the checker counts 200 and lists it.
  - D3c (checker lane, C_coParamsRedeclare): `Base & { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine' }` with a checker-only Base:
    - `a1` is listed and in the layer;
    - the own `className` is moved to `notableInherited` with `parent: DepBig`, because the checker's single `parent` is the first declaration.
- Missing fact: whether the prop's effective declaration is this source. The decision counts names the source declares, not members whose only declaration is the source.
- Corpora: 1 component in both gate-large and chakra-only, `ChakraDatePickerDayTable`. `offset` is listed with parent `DatePickerDayTableProps` and also held by the `SystemProperties` layer.

### D4. The same source reached by a listed path and a collapsed path
- Repro (all lanes): `DepBig & Omit<DepBig, 'a0'>`. The Omit path has 200 members and is listed; the plain path has 201 and collapses. All 200 props are listed and also in the layer.
- Cause: the decision is made per path. `one_layer_per_collapsed_source` merges only layers.
- Missing fact: the union of all paths' reaching members, decided once per (component, source).

### D5. An Omit key set that is not a literal union is read as "omits nothing" (C1)
- Repros (all lanes; TypeScript gives `{}` for the first two):
  - `Omit<DepBig, string>`: a layer of 201 members, none of which reach, plus 4 phantom `notableInherited` props (`className`, `id`, `onClick`, `style`);
  - `Omit<DepBig, 'a0' | (string & {})>`: the same;
  - ``Omit<DepBig, `a${1|2}`>``: `a1` and `a2` stay layer members although TypeScript removed them.
- Cause in `resolver/alias.rs:42-55`: an unknown key set leaves `state.omitted` unchanged, and `resolve_key_set_or_warn` returning `None` returns the chain unfiltered.
- Missing fact: whether the key set is finite and resolved.

### D6. A layer drops the component's destructuring defaults
- A default on any member in a layer is lost in every lane: `{ a3 = 'three' }` leaves `a3` only in the layer (C_dflt, C_checkerOnlyDflt, C_coParamsDflt).
- In a layer the checker made, even the notable default is lost: `className = 'dflt'` gives `defaultValue: null` on the notable prop (C_coParamsDflt). A layer the structural pass made keeps `'dflt'`.
- Missing fact: the component's destructuring, which the decision never reads.

### D7. A prop with several declarations is attributed to one parent (two counts)
- Repros:
  - Checker-only `DepBig & DepOther`: DepOther counts 199, because the shared `a5` and `className` are attributed to DepBig, so it is listed. The structural spelling collapses both, and `a5` and `className` then sit in two layers.
  - An interface augmented from another file (`declare module 'dep' { interface DepAug { augmented } }`) is split by file into 200 + 1. TypeScript gives 201 reaching, so it should collapse; both lanes list it.
- The cost is size and consistency, not loss.
- Missing fact: provenance as (source, key, every declaration), not a single parent.

### D8. Ambient by spelling (C3)
- A dependency's API interface named `PanelHTMLAttributes` (31 members: `className`, `onClick` and 29 API props) collapses at the ambient threshold of 30 in every lane. The suffix `*HTMLAttributes`, `*StyleProps` or `Aria*Attributes` is taken as evidence.
- Missing fact: the declaration's binding (a DOM file), not its name.

### D9. Essential props that are not on the notable list are hidden in layers
- `notable_html_attrs("")` is `onClick, onFocus, onBlur, className, style, id, tabIndex, aria-label`.
- A collapsed source's `children`, `key` or `ref` (C_children) exists only as a layer name, with no type.
- This is policy, not a bug, but the brief counts these names as notable.

Thresholds behave as specified in both lanes:
- 199, 200 and 201 members;
- ambient 29, 30 and 31;
- Omit taking 201 to 200 or 199 lists the source;
- `Omit<..., 'zzz'>` stays at 201 and collapses;
- under `all`, `ProjMid` 40 and `ProjBig200` collapse;
- `forwardRef`, `memo`, `memo(forwardRef)`, class components, polymorphic `as`, re-exports and `ComponentProps<typeof X>` all agree.

## Proposed closed allow-list: collapse source X in component C only when all of these are proven, otherwise list

1. **Binding.** X is identified by its declaration, either an interface, or a type-literal alias whose members both lanes attribute to X. A member with no proven owner is never held (D2).
2. **Path.** Every path from C's props type to X is one of:
   - the props type itself;
   - an intersection member;
   - an interface or class base, including a generic instantiation;
   - lib `Partial`, `Required` or `Readonly`;
   - lib `Omit` whose key set is a finite union of string literals, fully resolved.

   Anything else lists X: `Pick`, a mapped type, a conditional, an indexed access, a union arm not proven per arm, `string`, a branded string, a template literal or an unresolved key set (D5).
3. **Members.** The layer's members are those that X declares and that reach C with X as their only declaration, after Omit. They are the union over all paths, decided once per (C, X). Exclude from the layer, and list, any member that is also declared by:
   - C's own type;
   - a derived interface;
   - another source;
   - an intersection narrowing.

   This covers D3, D4 and D7.
4. **Count.** One function computes the count from rule 3, and both lanes call it with the same provenance. Collapse only when the count is over the threshold, so a redeclaration can drop X under it (D3, D3b).
5. **Code facts.** No member is named in C's destructuring (a default or a rest exclusion). Such members are listed (D6).
6. **Ambient.** Only the declaring file proves a source ambient, not its name (D8).
7. **Layering, separate from collapse.** A prop is React's only when every declaration of it is in @types/react (D1).

### Size cost (merged lane, from the `corpus/M-*.json` this binary produced)
- Rules 1, 3 and 4, applied per member (only the offending member is listed):
  - gate-large: 1 of 608 components with a layer; 1 member listed (`offset`);
  - chakra-only: 1 of 608; 1 member;
  - shadcn-ui: 0 of 6.
- The same rules applied to whole sources (any failing member lists the source):
  - gate-large: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - chakra-only: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - shadcn-ui: 0.
- Not measured from output: rule 2 (the Omit key form is not in the output), rule 5 (destructuring) and rule 6. All shadcn layers are `GlobalDOMEvents` from `@react-types/shared/src/dom.d.ts`, which is ambient by file, so rule 6 would not change them.

## Out of scope but seen (not caused by collapse)
- The structural lane loses everything (2 props kept) for these forms:
  - a conditional props type;
  - `Parameters<typeof f>[0]`;
  - `Cfg['props']` is the exception: it is read.
- `Pick<DepBig, Extract<keyof DepBig, `a1${string}`>>` loses 107 props in S, because `props.clear()` runs on an unresolved key set.
- A mapped type with `as` creates phantom props in S.
- S lists every React attribute for `ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & ...` (484 props) and for `ComponentProps<'div'> & {...}` (280), and the own `className` takes React's parent.
- A TSX syntax error makes `extract --quiet` exit non-zero with empty stderr.

## Not done
- No mutation proof and no oracle or corpus fetches. The corpora were the local ones.
- `html-attributes full` and `none` were not crossed with collapse.
- No generic components with type-parameter keys at the call site, beyond defaults.
- No incremental or cache paths. The `Layering::kept` vs merge mismatch is filtered silently in release builds (semantic.rs:465), but no input that triggers it was found.

# Red team: collapse decision and layering at fix/collapse-never-hide-on-silence (6aea3f4a)

Nothing was fixed and no repo file changed. The binary was built from `git archive 6aea3f4a` in `shrink/redteam-collapse-src`, with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=shrink/redteam-collapse-target` and rust 1.99.1.

Harness (scratch, not committed), in `/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/redteam-collapse/`:
- `gen.py` writes one project (`projects/g`) with 102 components. Each component is one grammar form over these sources:
  - dependency `dep`: interfaces of 201/200/199 members, a type-literal alias of 201, `*HTMLAttributes` of 29/30/31, `BoxStyleProps` 31, `DepChild extends DepBig` (narrows `a1`), `DepOther` (shares `a5` and `className`), `DepGen<T>`, an augmented `DepAug` (200 + 1 in `src/aug.ts`), a re-export;
  - project: an interface of 201, a type-literal alias of 201, `ProjBig200`, `ProjChild`, `ProjMid` 40.
- Lanes:
  - S `--no-checker`;
  - M default (merged);
  - C `--no-structural-fallback` (checker only);
  - and, under `dependencies`, also T `--semantic-timeout-ms 1` and N `--no-load-dependencies`.
- Each lane runs under all three modes, `dependencies` (the default and the addon's), `all` and `none`.
- `oracle.cjs` is the ground truth: TypeScript 5.9.3 `getPropertiesOfType` of each `Props_<id>` alias (the union of its arms for a union), with every declaration's parent and file.
- `analyze.py` checks the invariants and writes `rows.json`. A notable prop that copies a member of a same-source layer is the layer contract, not a duplicate.
- `corpus.sh` and `corpus.py` measure how often each class occurs, and the cost of the allow-list, on gate-large, chakra-only and shadcn-ui (`apps/v4`, 612 components).

## Invariant results

1. Every reaching prop appears exactly once (list, notable or layers). **Violated**: by loss in D1, by duplication in D2, D3, D4 and D7.
2. Own props are never in a layer. **Violated** in D3: an own redeclaration stays a layer member. In D3c an own prop is moved to `notableInherited` as the dependency's.
3. Every member of a collapsed layer reaches the component. **Violated** in D5 (an omitted key stays held, and props that do not exist appear). In D3 the base layer holds a member that a redeclaration overrides.
4. Lanes agree. On the 79 forms the structural lane can read, S, M and C collapse the same sources in all three modes. The decision still changes with how the type is spelled (D3b, D7). Checker-only forms (`Parameters<typeof f>[0]`, `Cfg['props']`) differ only because S cannot read them at all; that is expected.
5. Determinism. **Holds**:
   - M is byte-identical across two runs (stats dropped) in every mode.
   - Every component that shares a source without an Omit gets the same member list.
   - T (1 ms timeout) equals S on all 102 components.

Totals in `rows.json` (rows over modes and lanes, then distinct components):
- DUP: 3722 rows, 17 components;
- LOSS: 10101 rows, 21 components (most of it structural-lane loss on forms S declines, see Out of scope);
- LOSS_OWN: 22 rows, 2 components;
- LAYER_MEMBER_NOT_REACHING: 2424 rows, 3 components;
- PHANTOM: 467 rows, 4 components;
- LAYER_HOLDS_OVERRIDDEN_PROP: 30 rows, 4 components;
- OWN_AS_NOTABLE: 4 rows, 1 component;
- IN_TWO_LAYERS: 12 rows, 1 component;
- LANE_DISAGREE: 14 rows, 7 components (all checker-only forms).

## Discrepancy classes, grouped by the fact the decision lacked

### D1 (worst: silent loss in the default lane). "React's" means any one declaration is in @types/react
- Where:
  - `is_react_declared` (`crates/semantic/src/component.rs:35`) is `declarations.iter().any(...)`;
  - `apply_props` (`crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs:376-380`) drops every `react_declared` prop of a component that has a layer;
  - `Unanswered::Drop` then drops the structural prop as well.
- A prop that the user or a dependency also declares, in an intersection with a React type, is lost in M and C. The element layer stands for React's attribute, so the user's own type, JSDoc, and the name itself (`key`, `children`) are gone.
- Repros (M and C, every mode, `none` included):
  - `React.ComponentProps<'div'> & { className: 'mine'; onClick: (x: number) => void; title: 'own'; own: string }` loses `className`, `onClick` and `title`; S lists them (C_ownOverReact).
  - `DepBig & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { key?: string }` loses the own `key` (C_keyRef).
  - `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & Omit<DepBig, 'onClick'>` loses DepBig's `className`, `style`, `id` and `children` (C_cpwrAndDep).
  - The same happens wherever DepBig is listed, not collapsed: `ComponentProps<'div'> & DepBig` under `none`, and `Parameters<typeof f>[0] & ComponentProps<'div'>`, each lose 5 props.
- Missing fact: every declaration of the prop is React's (C1: one React declaration was taken as proof).
- Corpora: 0 detected. I compared S-lane props with a non-dependency parent, absent from M, in components with an element layer.
  - Latent case: Chakra `SystemProperties` members `color`, `content` and `translate` are also React names. They are safe today only because the source collapses (588 gate-large components). An Omit that drops the source under the threshold, in a component with an element layer, would lose them.

### D2. A type-literal alias source is both collapsed and fully listed (merged and checker lanes)
- Repros (M and C under `dependencies` and `all`; S is correct):
  - `DepAlias & {...}` and `ProjAlias & {...}`: the layer holds 201 members and the same 201 props are also listed;
  - a checker-only `PropsOf<typeof W>` with `W: FC<DepAlias>` does the same.
- Cause: the checker names no `parent` for a type-literal member. `keeps` keeps every prop with no parent (semantic.rs:692), and the structural layer holds members by (name, alias).
- This confirms review item 1 of the PR body as a regression.
- Missing fact: a type-literal member's binding to its alias.
- Corpora: 0.

### D3. A redeclared or overridden member stays in the layer and counts toward the threshold
- Repros (all lanes, `dependencies` and `all`, unless noted):
  - `interface P extends DepBig { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine' }`: the own `a1` and `className` are listed and also held by the DepBig layer (C_redeclare). The intersection form does the same (C_redeclareInter).
  - `DepChild` (a dependency child that narrows `a1`): the DepBig layer holds `a1`, and `a1` is listed (C_depChild). The same holds for ProjChild.
  - `interface P extends DepBig { a0: string }` (C_redeclareThreshold):
    - 201 declared, 200 reach, so the source should be listed at the threshold;
    - it collapses, and `a0` is both listed and in the layer.
  - `& { a0?: never }` and `Pick<DepBig,'a0'> & DepBig`: `a0` is listed and in the layer.
  - D3b (spelling): the structural lane counts what the source declares, the checker counts by parent. So the same type `DepChild` collapses DepBig at 201 when written directly. Written as `Parameters<typeof f>[0]`, the checker counts 200 and lists it.
  - D3c (checker lane, C_coParamsRedeclare): `Base & { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine' }` with a checker-only Base:
    - `a1` is listed and in the layer;
    - the own `className` is moved to `notableInherited` with `parent: DepBig`, because the checker's single `parent` is the first declaration.
- Missing fact: whether the prop's effective declaration is this source. The decision counts names the source declares, not members whose only declaration is the source.
- Corpora: 1 component in both gate-large and chakra-only, `ChakraDatePickerDayTable`. `offset` is listed with parent `DatePickerDayTableProps` and also held by the `SystemProperties` layer.

### D4. The same source reached by a listed path and a collapsed path
- Repro (all lanes): `DepBig & Omit<DepBig, 'a0'>`. The Omit path has 200 members and is listed; the plain path has 201 and collapses. All 200 props are listed and also in the layer.
- Cause: the decision is made per path. `one_layer_per_collapsed_source` merges only layers.
- Missing fact: the union of all paths' reaching members, decided once per (component, source).

### D5. An Omit key set that is not a literal union is read as "omits nothing" (C1)
- Repros (all lanes; TypeScript gives `{}` for the first two):
  - `Omit<DepBig, string>`: a layer of 201 members, none of which reach, plus 4 phantom `notableInherited` props (`className`, `id`, `onClick`, `style`);
  - `Omit<DepBig, 'a0' | (string & {})>`: the same;
  - ``Omit<DepBig, `a${1|2}`>``: `a1` and `a2` stay layer members although TypeScript removed them.
- Cause in `resolver/alias.rs:42-55`: an unknown key set leaves `state.omitted` unchanged, and `resolve_key_set_or_warn` returning `None` returns the chain unfiltered.
- Missing fact: whether the key set is finite and resolved.

### D6. A layer drops the component's destructuring defaults
- A default on any member in a layer is lost in every lane: `{ a3 = 'three' }` leaves `a3` only in the layer (C_dflt, C_checkerOnlyDflt, C_coParamsDflt).
- In a layer the checker made, even the notable default is lost: `className = 'dflt'` gives `defaultValue: null` on the notable prop (C_coParamsDflt). A layer the structural pass made keeps `'dflt'`.
- Missing fact: the component's destructuring, which the decision never reads.

### D7. A prop with several declarations is attributed to one parent (two counts)
- Repros:
  - Checker-only `DepBig & DepOther`: DepOther counts 199, because the shared `a5` and `className` are attributed to DepBig, so it is listed. The structural spelling collapses both, and `a5` and `className` then sit in two layers.
  - An interface augmented from another file (`declare module 'dep' { interface DepAug { augmented } }`) is split by file into 200 + 1. TypeScript gives 201 reaching, so it should collapse; both lanes list it.
- The cost is size and consistency, not loss.
- Missing fact: provenance as (source, key, every declaration), not a single parent.

### D8. Ambient by spelling (C3)
- A dependency's API interface named `PanelHTMLAttributes` (31 members: `className`, `onClick` and 29 API props) collapses at the ambient threshold of 30 in every lane. The suffix `*HTMLAttributes`, `*StyleProps` or `Aria*Attributes` is taken as evidence.
- Missing fact: the declaration's binding (a DOM file), not its name.

### D9. Essential props that are not on the notable list are hidden in layers
- `notable_html_attrs("")` is `onClick, onFocus, onBlur, className, style, id, tabIndex, aria-label`.
- A collapsed source's `children`, `key` or `ref` (C_children) exists only as a layer name, with no type.
- This is policy, not a bug, but the brief counts these names as notable.

Thresholds behave as specified in both lanes:
- 199, 200 and 201 members;
- ambient 29, 30 and 31;
- Omit taking 201 to 200 or 199 lists the source;
- `Omit<..., 'zzz'>` stays at 201 and collapses;
- under `all`, `ProjMid` 40 and `ProjBig200` collapse;
- `forwardRef`, `memo`, `memo(forwardRef)`, class components, polymorphic `as`, re-exports and `ComponentProps<typeof X>` all agree.

## Proposed closed allow-list: collapse source X in component C only when all of these are proven, otherwise list

1. **Binding.** X is identified by its declaration, either an interface, or a type-literal alias whose members both lanes attribute to X. A member with no proven owner is never held (D2).
2. **Path.** Every path from C's props type to X is one of:
   - the props type itself;
   - an intersection member;
   - an interface or class base, including a generic instantiation;
   - lib `Partial`, `Required` or `Readonly`;
   - lib `Omit` whose key set is a finite union of string literals, fully resolved.

   Anything else lists X: `Pick`, a mapped type, a conditional, an indexed access, a union arm not proven per arm, `string`, a branded string, a template literal or an unresolved key set (D5).
3. **Members.** The layer's members are those that X declares and that reach C with X as their only declaration, after Omit. They are the union over all paths, decided once per (C, X). Exclude from the layer, and list, any member that is also declared by:
   - C's own type;
   - a derived interface;
   - another source;
   - an intersection narrowing.

   This covers D3, D4 and D7.
4. **Count.** One function computes the count from rule 3, and both lanes call it with the same provenance. Collapse only when the count is over the threshold, so a redeclaration can drop X under it (D3, D3b).
5. **Code facts.** No member is named in C's destructuring (a default or a rest exclusion). Such members are listed (D6).
6. **Ambient.** Only the declaring file proves a source ambient, not its name (D8).
7. **Layering, separate from collapse.** A prop is React's only when every declaration of it is in @types/react (D1).

### Size cost (merged lane, from the `corpus/M-*.json` this binary produced)
- Rules 1, 3 and 4, applied per member (only the offending member is listed):
  - gate-large: 1 of 608 components with a layer; 1 member listed (`offset`);
  - chakra-only: 1 of 608; 1 member;
  - shadcn-ui: 0 of 6.
- The same rules applied to whole sources (any failing member lists the source):
  - gate-large: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - chakra-only: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - shadcn-ui: 0.
- Not measured from output: rule 2 (the Omit key form is not in the output), rule 5 (destructuring) and rule 6. All shadcn layers are `GlobalDOMEvents` from `@react-types/shared/src/dom.d.ts`, which is ambient by file, so rule 6 would not change them.

## Out of scope but seen (not caused by collapse)
- The structural lane loses everything (2 props kept) for these forms:
  - a conditional props type;
  - `Parameters<typeof f>[0]`;
  - `Cfg['props']` is the exception: it is read.
- `Pick<DepBig, Extract<keyof DepBig, `a1${string}`>>` loses 107 props in S, because `props.clear()` runs on an unresolved key set.
- A mapped type with `as` creates phantom props in S.
- S lists every React attribute for `ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & ...` (484 props) and for `ComponentProps<'div'> & {...}` (280), and the own `className` takes React's parent.
- A TSX syntax error makes `extract --quiet` exit non-zero with empty stderr.

## Not done
- No mutation proof and no oracle or corpus fetches. The corpora were the local ones.
- `html-attributes full` and `none` were not crossed with collapse.
- No generic components with type-parameter keys at the call site, beyond defaults.
- No incremental or cache paths. The `Layering::kept` vs merge mismatch is filtered silently in release builds (semantic.rs:465), but no input that triggers it was found.
